title: Earn the dependent-record test from the finite dual
statement: A finite rational predictive-flow dual must satisfy its exact inequality on ALL node pairs including diagonals. Its observable word statistic and computable multiplier bound yield a uniform reversible-null tail test on one consecutive stationary record,without a mixing time,gap,hidden-state count or independent resets. A history register is not automatically a reversible lift. Fixed/countable certificate choices carry selection weights;data-selected critics and arbitrary stopping do not inherit fixed-operator validity. A charged countable construction is complete only against the stated stationary ergodic alternatives with no reversible hidden realization,with no useful universal resource bound. The earlier informed interim assessment predates and does not independently accept this final lift.
